title: Jardinajj Alba urunwa Juramento luräna
intro: Inti jalsu janïr purinkipan amuktʼañ horasanakanjja, jamasat mä amtaw lurasïna. Mä suma herenciajj yapu apthapiñatakiw wakichtʼatäskäna, ukampis sapa achunak jan waltʼäwin uñjasirinakat jitheqtañatakiw mä amtar puripjjäna. Alwatakejja, taqe kunas jan uñtʼatjamaw uñstañapäna, ukat taqe lupʼiñatakejj mä yatichäwiw chʼiyar ramanakar grabatäna.
clues: Mä suma jardinar herencia katoqapjjta, ukat taqe achunakapajj jiwasakiw apthapiñäni sasaw arsuwayapjjta.
Alwat mistuñatakiw juramento lurapxta, kunapachatix pisinkirinakax jupanakan qullqip mayipkäna ukanakax wali ikisipkäna ukhakama.
Juramentojatx kuna excepción ukanakas jaqunukupxta ukat jan kunaninakan derechop jark’apxta, jan Allah munaspati jan sasisa.
Uka urux jan kuna pisinkir jaqis jardinar mantañapatakix maynit maynikamaw jiskʼat mistuwayapxta.
Taqi kun apthapiñatakisa ukat khiti apthapirirus mä chikat jan manqʼañapatakix taqpach chʼamanïkaspas ukhamwa amuyasipxta.
Ukat sartasipxta, arumanthix jardinajax tʼunjataw jikxatasïna, apthapitäkaspas ukhamaw chʼiyar tukutäna, ukat jan yäqatäpxtwa ukat arrepentisipxtwa sasaw sapxirïta.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
